upstream: E1 unified persistent pressure-head state qualified
C1R/F-R1 restricted unsaturated route qualified below h=-1 cm
E2C-R3 bounded endpoint-limit near-saturation WET_DRY face fallback qualified
R3 endpoint-limit micro-error shown hydrologically negligible on independent holdout

physical_composition.storage: theta(h), with theta=theta_s for h>=0 and base MvG below 0
physical_composition.internal_mass_ledger: one shared face flux value enters one adjacent cell and leaves the other
candidate_face_policy: UNSAT_UNSAT h<=-1 cm: qualified C1R table
WET_DRY with h_above in [-1,1] and h_below<=-1 cm: qualified E2C-R3
all other face classes: exact-reference fail-closed fallback, counted as UNQUALIFIED_FACE_FALLBACK
physical_composition.reference_face: full-accuracy steady_q using the same MvG/KSATFIT material
physical_composition.qualification_nonlinear_solver: scipy least_squares over head residual; qualification scaffolding only

case_families.required_event: at least one cell crosses from h<0 to h>=0 in candidate and reference
at least one initially saturated cell crosses from h>=0 to h<0 in candidate and reference

interpretation_policy: Mass conservation is a hard gate and is never waived as hydrologically negligible.
Internal endpoint differences already shown at ~1e-12 Ksat scale are not independently re-optimized in E3.
Hydraulic discrepancies are judged by their effect on storage, cumulative flux, heads and transition timing.
If hydrologic metrics pass but an UNQUALIFIED_FACE_FALLBACK occurs, classify a face-scope coverage gap rather than a hydrologic failure.
Qualification nonlinear-solver cost is diagnostic only; no runtime or MultiSWAP throughput claim follows.
hard_guards: No silent extrapolation of C1R or R3 outside qualified face classes.
No post-result tolerance or forcing tuning inside E3.
No response tangent qualification across saturation or endpoint-limit branches here.
No production runtime, groundwater or MultiSWAP admission from E3 alone.
